lines.trans: Did Hicham discover your secret about the baby?
Yes, he knows everything and claims to be the father.
You should maybe clarify things with him.
He is my boss, I cannot avoid him.
And how is the rehearsal going with Juliette?
Very well, but we have a big problem.
What is happening with Jean-Denis Gillières?
He is inviting Juliette onto his private yacht.
Did Juliette accept this invitation?
No, she categorically refuses to go there.
Careful, this man is a powerful patron.
Actresses are not courtesans!
You must use your diplomatic skills.
I refuse to give in to his ridiculous whims.
Think about the financing of Juliette's next movie.
Alright, I will speak to him with firmness.
